38 def _normalize_attention(raw, error=""):
39     if raw is None and error == "absent":
40         return {"state": "quiet", "reason": "", "source_state": "absent"}
41     if not isinstance(raw, dict):
42         return {"state": "unknown",
43                 "reason": error or "invalid attention record",
44                 "source_state": "unknown"}
45     state = str(raw.get("state") or "quiet").strip().lower()
46     if state not in _ATTENTION_STATES:
47         return {"state": "unknown",
48                 "reason": "invalid attention state: " + state,
49                 "source_state": state}
50     return {
51         "state": state,
52         "reason": str(raw.get("reason") or ""),
53         "source_state": state,
54         "state_since": raw.get("state_since"),
55         "updated_at": raw.get("updated_at") or raw.get("at"),
56         "failure_code": raw.get("failure_code"),
57         "schema": raw.get("schema"),
58         "provenance": (raw.get("provenance")
59                        if isinstance(raw.get("provenance"), list) else []),
60     }

81 def _humanize(secs):
82     if secs is None:
83         return "never"
84     if secs < 90:
85         return "just now"
86     for unit, span in (("m", 60), ("h", 3600), ("d", 86400)):
87         if secs < span * (99 if unit == "d" else 60 if unit == "m" else 36):
88             n = int(secs // span)
89             if n >= 1:
90                 last = (unit, n)
91     n = int(secs // 86400)
92     if n >= 1:
93         return f"{n}d ago"
94     n = int(secs // 3600)
95     if n >= 1:
96         return f"{n}h ago"
97     return f"{int(secs // 60)}m ago"

100 def _face_sections(text: str):
101     """Split the Face into its four narrative sections by ## heading."""
102     sections = {}
103     current, buf = None, []
104     for line in text.splitlines():
105         m = re.match(r"^##\s+(.+?)\s*$", line)
106         if m:
107             if current:
108                 sections[current] = "\n".join(buf).strip()
109             current = m.group(1).strip().lower()
110             buf = []
111         elif current:
112             buf.append(line)
113     if current:
114         sections[current] = "\n".join(buf).strip()
115     return sections

118 def _strip_md(text: str):
119     """Blockquote/bold markers out, keep the words."""
120     out = []
121     for line in text.splitlines():
122         line = re.sub(r"^\s*>\s?", "", line)
123         line = line.replace("**", "")
124         if re.fullmatch(r"\s*-{3,}\s*", line):
125             continue
126         out.append(line)
127     return "\n".join(out).strip()

130 def _first_sentence(text: str):
131     flat = " ".join(text.split())
132     m = re.search(r"^(.+?[.!?])(\s|$)", flat)
133     return (m.group(1) if m else flat)[:220]

136 def one_line(text, limit=110):
137     """One human-readable sentence for a status fact; never a hidden dump."""
138     flat = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
139     if not flat:
140         return ""
141     match = re.search(r"^(.{20,}?)(?<!\d)[.!?](?:\s|$)", flat)
142     sentence = match.group(0).strip() if match else flat
143     if len(sentence) <= limit:
144         return sentence
145     clipped = sentence[:limit - 1].rsplit(" ", 1)[0]
146     return (clipped or sentence[:limit - 1]) + "\u2026"

167 def _goal_md(text: str):
168     """Goal section with markdown bold kept (for the rich expanded tile):
169     blockquote markers and horizontal rules removed, and soft line-wraps
170     unwrapped so **bold** pairs never straddle a line break."""
171     lines = []
172     for line in text.splitlines():
173         line = re.sub(r"^\s*>\s?", "", line)
174         if re.fullmatch(r"\s*-{3,}\s*", line):
175             continue
176         lines.append(line)
177     paragraphs = re.split(r"\n\s*\n", "\n".join(lines).strip())
178     unwrapped = []
179     for para in paragraphs:
180         if re.match(r"\s*[-*]\s", para):
181             # bullet list: unwrap continuation lines into their bullet so
182             # **bold** pairs never straddle a wrap
183             items, cur = [], None
184             for ln in para.splitlines():
185                 if re.match(r"\s*[-*]\s", ln):
186                     if cur:
187                         items.append(cur)
188                     cur = ln.strip()
189                 elif cur:
190                     cur += " " + ln.strip()
191                 else:
192                     cur = ln.strip()
193             if cur:
194                 items.append(cur)
195             unwrapped.append("\n".join(items))
196         else:
197             unwrapped.append(" ".join(s.strip() for s in para.splitlines()))
198     return "\n\n".join(unwrapped)

217 def read_refinement(campaign_dir: str, stale_ok: bool = False):
218     """Coalesce dashboard reads; the spine remains the lifecycle authority.
219 
220     Source changes invalidate immediately. A two-second maximum age also
221     rechecks external artifact damage that does not alter the ledger/index.
222     Mutations still use the writer's sequence and exact-byte checks.
223 
224     stale_ok (the pages' reads, 2026-10-02): past the two seconds, while the
225     sources are unchanged, the last good result answers at once and ONE
226     background read rechecks it for the next load - a page waits for the
227     spine only when the record itself changed (the Cave of Wonders paid a
228     full spine read on every load, its loads being more than 2 s apart).
229     """
230     root = Path(campaign_dir).resolve()
231     key = os.path.normcase(str(root))
232     with _REFINEMENT_READ_LOCK:
233         slot = _REFINEMENT_READ_SLOTS.setdefault(key, {'lock': threading.Lock()})
234     if stale_ok:
235         with _REFINEMENT_READ_LOCK:
236             cached = slot.get('result') if slot.get('fingerprint') == _refinement_fingerprint(root) else None
237             fresh = cached is not None and time.monotonic() < slot.get('until', 0)
238             if cached is not None and cached.get('ok') and not fresh and not slot.get('refreshing'):
239                 try:
240                     threading.Thread(target=_refresh_refinement_slot, args=(str(root), slot),
241                                      name='refinement-recheck', daemon=True).start()
242                     slot['refreshing'] = True
243                 except RuntimeError:
244                     cached = None       # no thread: this load reads synchronously
245         if cached is not None and cached.get('ok'):
246             return deepcopy(cached)
247     with slot['lock']:
248         return _read_refinement_slot(root, slot)
249 
250 
251 def _read_refinement_slot(root, slot):
252     """The slot's read under its lock: answer from the slot while fresh, else read and store."""
253     fingerprint = _refinement_fingerprint(root)
254     if (slot.get('fingerprint') == fingerprint and
255             time.monotonic() < slot.get('until', 0)):
256         return deepcopy(slot['result'])
257     result = _read_refinement_uncached(str(root))
258     if _refinement_fingerprint(root) == fingerprint:
259         slot.update(fingerprint=fingerprint, result=deepcopy(result),
260                     until=time.monotonic() + (2.0 if result and result.get('ok') else .25))
261     return result
262 
263 
264 def _refresh_refinement_slot(campaign_dir, slot):
265     # A recheck that raises drops the good answer it was guarding: the next page read is synchronous and shows the
266     # failure, never the old result standing in for it (Grok, 2026-10-02). A non-ok read is stored by the slot read
267     # itself, and a page never answers stale from a non-ok result.
268     try:
269         with slot['lock']:
270             _read_refinement_slot(Path(campaign_dir), slot)
271     except Exception:
272         with slot['lock']:
273             slot.pop('result', None); slot.pop('fingerprint', None); slot['until'] = 0
274     finally:
275         with _REFINEMENT_READ_LOCK:
276             slot['refreshing'] = False
277

291 def refinement_items(campaign_dir, state):
292     """Opening metadata from the verified event fold; no Python lifecycle fold."""
293     items = []
294     for step_id, s in state.get("slices", {}).items():
295         for product_id, revision_id in s.get("candidate", {}).items():
296             rev = s["revisions"][revision_id]
297             imported = [r for r in s['revisions'].values()
298                         if r['product_id'] == product_id and r.get('source_history')]
299             base = max((r['source_history']['iteration'] for r in imported), default=-1)
300             presentations = [p for p in s.get('presentations', [])
301                              if any(m['product_id'] == product_id for m in p['members'])]
302             offset = 0
303             if imported and presentations:
304                 first = presentations[0]
305                 first_member = next(m for m in first['members'] if m['product_id'] == product_id)
306                 first_source = s['revisions'][first_member['revision_id']].get('source_history')
307                 offset = (first_source['iteration'] if first_source else base + 1) - first['round']
308             displayed_round = (rev['source_history']['iteration'] if rev.get('source_history')
309                                else s['round'] + offset if presentations or not imported else base + 1)
310             item = {"what": product_id, "path": rev["path"], "where_text": rev["path"],
311                     "step": step_id, "date": rev.get("at", state.get("last_event_at", "")),
312                     "route": None, "run": None, "openable": True, "managed": True,
313                     "revision_id": revision_id, "product_id": product_id, "hash": rev["hash"], "round": displayed_round,
314                     "provisional": rev.get("provisional"),
315                     "phase": s["phase"], "history": []}
316             for p in s.get("presentations", []):
317                 for member in p["members"]:
318                     if member["product_id"] != product_id:
319                         continue
320                     shown_round = p['round'] + offset
321                     entry = {"what": ("Initial draft" if shown_round == 0 else "Refinement %s" % shown_round),
322                              "path": member["path"], "hash": member["hash"], "step": step_id,
323                              "product_id": product_id, "revision_id": member["revision_id"],
324                              "presentation_id": p["id"], "round": p["round"], "date": p.get("at", ""),
325                              "accepted": p["id"] == s.get("accepted_presentation"),
326                              "managed": True, "openable": True}
327                     item["history"].append(entry)
328                     if member["revision_id"] == revision_id:
329                         item["presentation_id"] = p["id"]
330                         item["product_id"] = product_id
331             presented_ids = {v['revision_id'] for v in item['history']}
332             for old in imported:
333                 if old['revision_id'] in presented_ids or old['revision_id'] == revision_id:
334                     continue
335                 origin = old['source_history']; n = origin['iteration']
336                 item['history'].append({'what':('Initial draft' if n == 0 else f'Refinement {n}'),
337                     'path':old['path'],'hash':old['hash'],'step':step_id,'product_id':product_id,
338                     'revision_id':old['revision_id'],'date':origin['at'],'managed':True,'openable':True,
339                     'source_history':origin})
340             items.append(item)
341     return items

344 def _closed_today(roadmap, step_id):
345     """True when the step's last status_flip to done is stamped today (the CLI stamps a date)."""
346     from datetime import datetime as _dt
347     try:
348         flips = [ev for ev in (roadmap or {}).get("roadmap_events") or []
349                  if ev.get("kind") == "status_flip" and ev.get("to") == "done" and str(ev.get("step_id")) == str(step_id)]
350         at = str(flips[-1].get("at") or "").strip() if flips else ""
351         when = _dt.fromisoformat(at.replace("Z", "+00:00")) if at else None
352         if when is not None and when.tzinfo is not None:
353             when = when.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
354         return when is not None and when.date() == _dt.now().date()
355     except Exception:
356         return False

532         heartbeat["pending_request"] = None
533         heartbeat["human_wait"] = ""
534         human_wait_face = ""
535         if not refinement.get("ok"):
536             attention.update(state="unknown", reason="Refinement state unavailable")
537             gaps.append("Refinement state unavailable: " + str(refinement.get("error")))
538             for step in steps:
539                 if step["status"] == "done":
540                     step["status"] = "waiting"
541         else:
542             state = refinement["state"]
543             display_rounds = {}
544             for item in refinement_items(campaign_dir, state):
545                 display_rounds[item['step']] = max(display_rounds.get(item['step'], 0), item['round'])
546             attention["producer_recovery_required"] = any(
547                 item.get("status") == "pending_steward_review" and
548                 item.get("terminal") in ("failed", "orphaned", "reaped", "cancelled", "interrupted")
549                 for item in state.get("producer_handoffs", {}).values())
550             pending = state.get("pending_request")
551             attention["pending_requests"] = [dict(r, asked_at=p.get("at"))
552                 for sl in state["slices"].values() for r in sl.get("review_requests", [])
553                 if r.get("status") == "pending"
554                 for p in sl.get("presentations", []) if p["id"] == r["presentation_id"]]
555             attention["work_digest"] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({sid: {
556                 "candidate": sl.get("candidate"), "requirements": sl.get("requirements"),
557                 "depends_on": sl.get("depends_on")}
558                 for sid, sl in state["slices"].items()}, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
559             attention["pending_request"] = pending
560             heartbeat["pending_request"] = pending
561             human_wait_face = pending.get("purpose", "") if pending else ""
562             heartbeat["human_wait"] = human_wait_face
563             # W0 (2026-09-28; Grok's hold on W0): on a managed campaign the wait names its subject AT READ, from the
564             # ids the pending request already carries — the decision he owes, its step, its presentation, and when
565             # it was asked (the presentation's own time: the wait's age, never the strip's last touch)
566             if pending:
567                 heartbeat["wait_ref"] = "decision:%s" % pending.get("id")
568                 heartbeat["wait_step_id"] = pending.get("step_id")
569                 heartbeat["wait_presentation_id"] = pending.get("presentation_id")
570                 heartbeat["wait_asked_at"] = next((r.get("asked_at") for r in attention["pending_requests"]
571                                                    if r.get("id") == pending.get("id")), None)
572             for step in steps:
573                 if step["id"] in state["slices"]:
574                     step["refinement"] = dict(state["slices"][step["id"]])
575                     step['refinement']['display_round'] = display_rounds.get(step['id'], step['refinement']['round'])
576                     step["refinement"]["producer_handoffs"] = [
577                         item for item in state.get("producer_handoffs", {}).values()
578                         if item.get("step_id") == step["id"]
579                         and item.get("status") == "pending_steward_review"]
580                     failed_producers = [item for item in step["refinement"]["producer_handoffs"]
581                                         if item.get("terminal") in ("failed", "orphaned", "reaped", "cancelled", "interrupted")]
582                     if failed_producers:
583                         gaps.append(step["name"] + ": producer failed; Steward recovery required")
584                         if step["status"] != "done":
585                             step["status"] = "waiting"
586                             step["waiting_on"] = "Producer failed; Steward recovery required"
587             unmapped = [item for item in state.get("producer_handoffs", {}).values()
588                         if not item.get("step_id")
589                         and item.get("status") == "pending_steward_review"]
590             if unmapped:
591                 gaps.append(str(len(unmapped)) + " completed work handoff(s) need Steward to identify their slice")
592             if pending and attention.get("state") != "working":
593                 attention.update(state="needs_you", reason=human_wait_face)
594             elif attention.get("state") in ("needs_you", "blocked"):
595                 attention.update(state="quiet", reason="No pending refinement request")
596             if not refinement["projection_status"]["consistent"]:
597                 gaps.append("Refinement views need repair: " + str(refinement["projection_status"].get("error", "projection-lag")))
598             finished = refinement.get("finished_projection")
599             if finished and not finished.get("consistent"):
600                 gaps.append("Finished Deliverables needs repair: " + str(finished.get("error")))
601             nav = refinement.get("navigation")
602             if isinstance(nav, dict):
603                 for step in steps:
604                     extra = nav.get(step.get("id"))
605                     if isinstance(extra, dict):
606                         step["navigation"] = extra
607         done = sum(1 for s in steps if s["status"] == "done")
608     from .navigation_compat import with_compat_navigation
609     organized = with_compat_navigation({"name": root.name, "steps": steps}, roadmap)
610     steps = organized["steps"]
611     m = {
612         "navigation_mode": organized["navigation_mode"],
613         "navigation_fallback": organized.get("navigation_fallback"),
614         "refinement": refinement,
615         "dir": str(root),
616         "name": root.name,
617         "goal": goal,
618         "goal_brief": _first_sentence(goal),
619         "goal_md": goal_md,
620         "steps": steps,
621         "steps_done": done,
622         "steps_total": len(steps),
623         "map": derive_product_map(steps),
624         "work_map": work_product_map(steps),
625         "plate": read_plate(str(root)),
626         "goal_flips": goal_flips,
627         "goal_revision": goal_revision,
628         "goal_reread": goal_reread,
629         "heartbeat": heartbeat,
630         "human_wait_face": human_wait_face,
631         "grasscatch": grasscatch,
632         "attention": attention,
633         "freshness": freshness,
634         "history": {"started": started, "days": days, "history_md": history_md},
635         "gaps": gaps,
636     }
637     focused, _focus_warning = _focused_step(m)
638     m["now_step_id"] = (focused or {}).get("id")
639     # W1 (2026-09-28): the next-in-the-plan horizon, computed ONCE here for every reader of the map — the
640     # cockpit's Next steps renders this list; the card on the High Seat computes the same call on the same map
641     m["next_in_plan"] = [dict(s) for s in next_in_plan(m, 3)[0]]
642     # W4 (2026-09-28): the repairs PROPOSED and not yet resolved on his word — the tile says "proposed: N corrections"
643     try:
644         from .repair import open_proposals as _open_proposals
645         m["repair_proposals"] = [{"proposal_id": str(e.get("proposal_id") or ""), "count": int(e.get("count") or 0),
646                                   "after": e.get("after") if isinstance(e.get("after"), dict) else {},
647                                   "corrections": [c for c in (e.get("corrections") or []) if isinstance(c, dict)],
648                                   "at": e.get("at") or ""}
649                                  for e in _open_proposals((roadmap or {}).get("roadmap_events"))]
650     except Exception:
651         m["repair_proposals"] = []
652     return m

682 def list_plates(project_dir: str):
683     """One plate per effort that has anatomy.json."""
684     plates = []
685     seen = set()
686     for e in discover_efforts(project_dir):
687         edir = str(Path(project_dir) / e["rel"]) if e["rel"] else project_dir
688         pl = read_plate(edir)
689         if not pl:
690             continue
691         key = pl.get("deliverableId") or e["rel"] or e["name"]
692         if key in seen:
693             continue
694         seen.add(key)
695         pl = dict(pl)
696         pl["effort"] = e["rel"]
697         plates.append(pl)

701 def work_product_map(steps):
702     """Backbone of the *deliverable* (Patton: flow across, detail down).
703     Same steps as the plan — grouped, not a second store."""
704     groups = []
705     seen = set()
706     for tag in _PART_TAGS:
707         items = [s for s in (steps or []) if s.get("part") == tag]
708         if not items:
709             continue
710         for s in items:
711             seen.add(s.get("id"))
712         done = sum(1 for s in items if s.get("status") == "done")
713         groups.append({
714             "tag": tag,
715             "label": _PART_LABELS.get(tag, tag),
716             "done": done,
717             "total": len(items),
718             "steps": items,
719         })
720     rest = [s for s in (steps or []) if s.get("id") not in seen]
721     if rest:
722         done = sum(1 for s in rest if s.get("status") == "done")
723         groups.append({
724             "tag": "",
725             "label": "Outline",
726             "done": done,
727             "total": len(rest),
728             "steps": rest,
729         })
730     return groups
731 
732 
733 def derive_product_map(steps):
734     """Product map = tagged roadmap steps. Not a second file."""
735     lines = []
736     seen = set()
737     for tag in _PART_TAGS:
738         for s in steps or []:
739             if s.get("part") == tag:
740                 seen.add(s.get("id"))
741                 bit = tag + ": " + (s.get("name") or "(unnamed)")
742                 bit += " (" + (s.get("status") or "") + ")"
743                 if s.get("gate"):
744                     bit += " · gate"
745                 elif tag in ("slice", "rigor", "integrate", "harden"):
746                     bit += " · no gate"
747                 lines.append(bit)
748     for s in steps or []:
749         if s.get("id") not in seen:
750             lines.append("untagged: " + (s.get("name") or "(unnamed)")
751                          + " (" + (s.get("status") or "") + ")")
752     return lines
753

755 def suggest_effort_name(goal_brief, limit=4):
756     """A short human effort name derived from the GOAL (zero-model, instant —
757     John 2026-08-25: 'when I do the rename can the steward give a
758     suggestion?'). Takes the goal's first few salient words; a SUGGESTION the
759     rename prompt prefills and the user edits or replaces — never applied on
760     its own. Empty string when the goal is too thin to suggest from."""
761     words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z][\w\-]*", str(goal_brief or ""))
762     picked = [w for w in words if w.lower() not in _NAME_STOP][:limit]
763     name = " ".join(picked).strip()[:40].strip()
764     return name if len(name) >= 3 else ""

767 def read_swarm_trails(campaign_dir: str):
768     """Scoped, lease-aware heartbeat files from supervised swarm seats.
769 
770     Trio's shared swarm-lookin contract treats 90 seconds without a refreshed
771     trail as death. The cockpit mirrors that boundary: stale or malformed
772     files remain visible as evidence, but are never presented as live work.
773     """
774     root = Path(campaign_dir)
775     candidates = []
776     for folder in (root, root / ".ecgberht"):
777         if not folder.is_dir():
778             continue
779         try:
780             names = list(folder.iterdir())
781         except OSError:
782             continue
783         for p in names:
784             if not p.is_file():
785                 continue
786             if not _SWARM_HEARTBEAT_NAME.fullmatch(p.name):
787                 continue
788             file_age = _age(p)
789             label = re.sub(r"^heartbeat-r\d+-", "", p.stem,
790                            flags=re.I) or p.stem
791             try:
792                 raw = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
793             except Exception:
794                 candidates.append({"label": label, "doing": "",
795                                    "why": "", "next": "",
796                                    "load_bearing": None, "rabbit": None,
797                                    "state": "unknown",
798                                    "age": _humanize(file_age),
799                                    "age_seconds": file_age,
800                                    "reason": "unreadable heartbeat",
801                                    "valid": False, "source": str(p)})
802                 continue
803             valid = (
804                 isinstance(raw, dict)
805                 and all(isinstance(raw.get(k), str)
806                         for k in ("doing", "why", "next"))
807                 and isinstance(raw.get("load_bearing"), bool)
808                 and isinstance(raw.get("rabbit"), bool)
809                 and isinstance(raw.get("ts"), (str, int, float))
810                 and not isinstance(raw.get("ts"), bool)
811                 and str(raw.get("ts")).strip() != ""
812             )
813             if not valid:
814                 candidates.append({"label": label, "doing": "",
815                                    "why": "", "next": "",
816                                    "load_bearing": None, "rabbit": None,
817                                    "state": "unknown",
818                                    "age": _humanize(file_age),
819                                    "age_seconds": file_age,
820                                    "reason": "invalid heartbeat schema",
821                                    "valid": False, "source": str(p)})
822                 continue
823             # Trio's supervisor uses Number(ts) as milliseconds and falls back
824             # to file mtime when ts is non-numeric. Mirror that clock exactly;
825             # touching an old numeric payload must not resurrect a dead seat.
826             payload_ms = None
827             try:
828                 parsed = float(raw["ts"])
829                 if math.isfinite(parsed) and parsed != 0:
830                     payload_ms = parsed
831             except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
832                 pass
833             if payload_ms is None:
834                 age_seconds = file_age
835                 clock_source = "mtime"
836             else:
837                 age_seconds = time.time() - (payload_ms / 1000.0)
838                 clock_source = "payload"
839             state = ("fresh" if age_seconds is not None
840                       and age_seconds < SWARM_HEARTBEAT_LEASE_SECONDS
841                       else "stale")
842             candidates.append({
843                 "label": label,
844                 "doing": raw["doing"],
845                 "why": raw["why"],
846                 "next": raw["next"],
847                 "load_bearing": raw["load_bearing"],
848                 "rabbit": raw["rabbit"],
849                 "state": state,
850                 "age": _humanize(age_seconds),
851                 "age_seconds": age_seconds,
852                 "reason": ("" if state == "fresh" else
853                            "heartbeat lease expired"),
854                 "clock_source": clock_source,
855                 "clock_skew_seconds": (round(-age_seconds, 3)
856                                        if age_seconds is not None
857                                        and age_seconds < 0 else 0),
858                 "valid": True,
859                 "source": str(p),
860             })
861 
862     # Root and .ecgberht can contain copies of the same supervised seat. One
863     # identity produces one row: newest valid evidence wins; an invalid copy
864     # can never hide an older valid trail. Keep duplicate provenance visible
865     # in the structured record for diagnosis without painting two live seats.
866     grouped = {}
867     for item in candidates:
868         grouped.setdefault(item["label"].casefold(), []).append(item)
869     found = []
870     for items in grouped.values():
871         valid_items = [item for item in items if item["valid"]]
872         pool = valid_items or items
873         winner = min(
874             pool,
875             key=lambda item: (float("inf") if item["age_seconds"] is None
876                               else item["age_seconds"]),
877         )
878         winner = dict(winner)
879         winner["duplicate_sources"] = len(items)
880         winner["sources"] = sorted(item["source"] for item in items)
881         winner.pop("valid", None)
882         winner.pop("source", None)
883         found.append(winner)
884     found.sort(key=lambda seat: seat["label"].casefold())
885     return found
886 
887 
888 #: (2026-09-04, John: "what is running is always the steward") the status looks
889 #: THROUGH the steward to the skill it commissioned. A trio skill writes its own
890 #: status table to a status log under the campaign dir (Foreman
891 #: ``_foreman-status.log``, Crucible ``_crucible-status*.log``, ...); the newest
892 #: FRESH one is the run of record for "what is happening right now".
893 STATUS_LOOKTHROUGH_FRESH_SECONDS = 900
894 _STATUS_LOG_NAME = re.compile(r"^_?([A-Za-z]+)-status[\w.-]*\.log$", re.I)
895 _STATUS_ROW = re.compile(
896     r"^(Effort|Doing|Status|Tests|Blocker|Procs|Journal|ETA|To do)\s{2,}(.*)$")
897 _STATUS_HEAD = re.compile(
898     r"\[(\d\d:\d\d)\]\s+(.+?)\s+\u00b7\s+(t=0|final|t\+\d+[hm]\d*m?)\s*$")
899 _SKILL_LABELS = {"foreman": "Foreman build", "crucible": "Crucible plan",
900                  "gandalf": "Gandalf review", "researchprime": "researchPrime",
901                  "jumper": "Jumper", "ramanujan": "Ramanujan",
902                  "litreview": "literature review"}
903 _LOOK_SKIP_DIRS = {".git", "node_modules", "_boneyard", ".foreman", "__pycache__",
904                    ".anchor", ".ecgberht", "_foreman-logs"}
905 #: typical length of a roadmap step by part tag, minutes — the ETA when the
906 #: commissioned run does not carry its own (an estimate, and labelled so)
907 _PART_MINUTES = {"research": 30, "slice": 45, "rigor": 30, "integrate": 30,
908                  "harden": 30}
909 #: plan documents that are a plan forward — auto-rows in the deliverables
910 #: register (John, 2026-09-04: a plan lives as a clickable link in the work
911 #: flow AND a bullet summary in the dialogue; never something he hunts for)
912 _PLAN_DOC_NAME = re.compile(
913     r"^(PLAN|MASTER-PLAN|IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN|NORTH-STAR|[\w.-]*-PLAN)\.md$", re.I)
914 
915 
916 #: (2026-09-04, John) a model's session/usage limit must be TOLD, never swallowed.
917 MODEL_LIMIT_RE = re.compile(
918     r"usage limit|rate.?limit|limit reached|hit your limit|reached your limit|"
919     r"out of (?:extra )?usage|quota|resets? (?:at|in) |too many requests|\b429\b|"
920     r"resource exhausted|overloaded|capacity", re.I)
921 
922 
923 def classify_model_limit(text):
924     """The limit phrase a model/CLI message carries, or "" when it is not a limit."""
925     m = MODEL_LIMIT_RE.search(str(text or ""))
926     return m.group(0) if m else ""
927

929 def _halt_reason(text):
930     """The run's own HALT/STOP reason line when it comes AFTER the last status
931     table (a run that ended); "" otherwise."""
932     t = str(text or "")
933     last_todo = t.rfind("\nTo do")
934     m = None
935     for m in re.finditer(r"HALT/STOP reason:\s*(.+)", t):
936         pass
937     if not m or m.start() < last_todo:
938         return ""
939     return m.group(1).strip()
940

942 def write_attention(campaign_dir, state, reason, failure_code=None, by="engine"):
943     """Atomic write of the ONE attention flag (the same shape the steward writes)."""
944     f = Path(campaign_dir) / ".ecgberht" / "attention.json"
945     f.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
946     now = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
947     prev, _ = _read_json(f)
948     prev = prev if isinstance(prev, dict) else {}
949     rec = {"state": state, "reason": str(reason or ""), "updated_at": now,
950            "state_since": (prev.get("state_since") if prev.get("state") == state
951                            else now),
952            "failure_code": failure_code,
953            "provenance": ((prev.get("provenance") if isinstance(prev.get("provenance"), list)
954                            else []) + [{"by": by, "at": now, "state": state}])[-8:]}
955     tmp = f.with_name(f.name + ".%s.tmp" % os.getpid())
956     tmp.write_text(json.dumps(rec, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
957     os.replace(tmp, f)
958     return rec
959

961 def raise_halt_attention(campaign_dir, status):
962     """A commissioned run that STOPPED while the flag still says "working" is
963     a lie on the High Seat: flip it to needs_you with the run's own reason (a
964     model session limit above all). Returns the new flag or None (no change)."""
965     halt = (status or {}).get("halt") or {}
966     if not halt.get("reason"):
967         return None
968     att, err = _read_json(Path(campaign_dir) / ".ecgberht" / "attention.json")
969     state = str((att or {}).get("state") or "").lower() if isinstance(att, dict) else ""
970     if state != "working":
971         return None
972     code = "MODEL_LIMIT" if halt.get("limit") else "RUN_HALTED"
973     label = ("model session limit: " + halt["limit"] + " \u2014 " if halt.get("limit") else "") \
974         + (halt.get("skill") or "run") + " stopped: " + halt["reason"]
975     return write_attention(campaign_dir, "needs_you", label[:400], failure_code=code)
976 
977 
978 def parse_status_table(text):
979     """The LAST status table in a trio status log (John's locked rows) ->
980     ``{"head": {"at","title","tick"} | None, "rows": {...}}`` or None."""
981     lines = str(text or "").splitlines()
982     rows, head = {}, None
983     i = len(lines) - 1
984     while i >= 0:
985         m = _STATUS_ROW.match(lines[i].rstrip())
986         if m:
987             key = m.group(1).lower().replace(" ", "_")
988             if key not in rows:
989                 rows[key] = m.group(2).strip()
990             if key == "effort":
991                 for j in range(i - 1, max(-1, i - 4), -1):
992                     h = _STATUS_HEAD.search(lines[j])
993                     if h:
994                         head = {"at": h.group(1), "title": h.group(2).strip(),
995                                 "tick": h.group(3)}
996                         break
997                 break
998         i -= 1
999     if not rows:
1000         return None
1001     return {"head": head, "rows": rows}
1002 
1003 
1004 def _newest_status_log(campaign_dir, depth=3):
1005     root = Path(campaign_dir)
1006     best = None
1007 
1008     def walk(d, level):
1009         nonlocal best
1010         try:
1011             entries = list(d.iterdir())
1012         except OSError:
1013             return
1014         for p in entries:
1015             name = p.name
1016             try:
1017                 is_dir = p.is_dir()
1018             except OSError:
1019                 continue
1020             if is_dir:
1021                 if level < depth and name not in _LOOK_SKIP_DIRS \
1022                         and not name.startswith("."):
1023                     walk(p, level + 1)
1024                 continue
1025             m = _STATUS_LOG_NAME.match(name)
1026             if not m:
1027                 continue
1028             try:
1029                 mt = p.stat().st_mtime
1030             except OSError:
1031                 continue
1032             if best is None or mt > best[1]:
1033                 best = (p, mt, m.group(1).lower())
1034 
1035     walk(root, 0)
1036     return best
1037 
1038 
1039 def status_lookthrough(campaign_dir, now=None):
1040     """The commissioned run of record when one is FRESH — parsed from the
1041     skill's OWN status log. None when nothing fresh (then the steward's own
1042     state speaks). ``final`` marks a run that has ended (its last table)."""
1043     found = _newest_status_log(campaign_dir)
1044     if not found:
1045         return None
1046     p, mt, skill = found
1047     age = (now or time.time()) - mt
1048     if age > STATUS_LOOKTHROUGH_FRESH_SECONDS:
1049         return None
1050     try:
1051         text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
1052     except OSError:
1053         return None
1054     parsed = parse_status_table(text[-20000:])
1055     if not parsed:
1056         return None
1057     rows, head = parsed["rows"], parsed["head"] or {}
1058     label = _SKILL_LABELS.get(skill, skill.capitalize())
1059     title = head.get("title") or label
1060     doing = rows.get("doing", "")
1061     halt_reason = _halt_reason(text[-20000:])
1062     blocker = rows.get("blocker", "")
1063     limit = classify_model_limit(halt_reason) or classify_model_limit(blocker)
1064     try:
1065         source = os.path.relpath(str(p), str(campaign_dir)).replace(os.sep, "/")
1066     except ValueError:
1067         source = str(p)
1068     return {"skill": label, "title": title, "doing": doing,
1069             "label": title + (" \u00b7 " + doing if doing else ""),
1070             "effort": rows.get("effort", ""), "status": rows.get("status", ""),
1071             "tests": rows.get("tests", ""), "blocker": rows.get("blocker", ""),
1072             "procs": rows.get("procs", ""), "eta": rows.get("eta", ""),
1073             "todo": rows.get("to_do", ""), "final": head.get("tick") == "final",
1074             "halt_reason": halt_reason, "limit": limit,
1075             "age": _humanize(age), "age_seconds": age, "source": source}

1084 def _parse_epoch(ts):
1085     if isinstance(ts, (int, float)):
1086         return float(ts) / 1000.0 if ts > 1e11 else float(ts)
1087     s = str(ts or "").strip()
1088     if not s:
1089         return None
1090     try:
1091         from datetime import datetime
1092         return datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00")).timestamp()
1093     except Exception:
1094         return None
1095

1097 def _slice_started_epoch(campaign_dir, step_id):
1098     """When the active step became active — the newest roadmap event that
1099     names it and says active/started. None when the roadmap never said."""
1100     roadmap, err = _read_json(Path(campaign_dir) / "roadmap.json")
1101     if err or not roadmap or not step_id:
1102         return None
1103     best = None
1104     for ev in roadmap.get("roadmap_events") or []:
1105         if str(ev.get("step_id") or ev.get("id") or "") != str(step_id):
1106             continue
1107         fields = ev.get("fields") if isinstance(ev.get("fields"), dict) else {}
1108         st = " ".join([*(str(ev.get(k) or "") for k in ("status", "to", "kind")),
1109                        str(fields.get("status") or "")]).lower()
1110         if "active" not in st and "start" not in st:
1111             continue
1112         ep = _parse_epoch(ev.get("at") or ev.get("ts") or ev.get("time")
1113                           or ev.get("when"))
1114         if ep and (best is None or ep > best):
1115             best = ep
1116     return best

1119 def _real_wait(text):
1120     """A strip that says "none" / "-" is not waiting on anyone (the Blocker row
1121     read "waiting on you: none" on a live effort, 2026-09-04)."""
1122     t = str(text or "").strip()
1123     if t.lower().rstrip(".") in ("", "none", "nothing", "-", "\u2014", "n/a"):
1124         return ""
1125     # A negative wait followed by its explanation is still no action for John.
1126     # Keep ordinary phrases such as "none of these plans is approved" intact.
1127     if re.match(r"^(?:none|nothing)\s+[\u2014\u2013-]\s+", t, re.IGNORECASE):
1128         return ""
1129     return t

1132 def _focused_step(m):
1133     """Use the declared work item; never guess among several active steps."""
1134     steps = m.get("steps") or []
1135     current_id = (m.get("heartbeat") or {}).get("current_step_id")
1136     if not current_id:                     # read-side: the one pinned step names the work item
1137         pinned = [s for s in steps if isinstance(s.get("navigation"), dict)
1138                   and (s["navigation"].get("pin") or s["navigation"].get("current"))]
1139         if len(pinned) == 1:
1140             return pinned[0], ""
1141     if current_id:
1142         found = next((s for s in steps if str(s.get("id")) == str(current_id)), None)
1143         if found:
1144             return found, ""
1145         return None, "Current work item is unavailable: current_step_id does not match the roadmap."
1146     active = [s for s in steps if s.get("status") == "active"]
1147     if len(active) == 1:
1148         return active[0], ""
1149     if len(active) > 1:
1150         names = ", ".join(str(s.get("name") or s.get("id") or "?") for s in active[:6])
1151         if len(active) > 6:
1152             names += " and %d more" % (len(active) - 6)
1153         return None, ("Current work item is unavailable: %d steps are active and no current_step_id is set "
1154                       "- the steward must pin one: %s" % (len(active), names))
1155     open_steps = [s for s in steps if s.get("status") not in ("done", "parked", "cancelled", "dropped")]
1156     if steps and not open_steps:
1157         return None, ""                        # every step closed or parked: nothing to pin
1158     if steps:
1159         return None, ("Current work item is unavailable: no step is active and no current_step_id is set "
1160                       "- the steward must pin one of the %d open steps" % len(open_steps))
1161     return None, ""
1162 
1163 
1164 _CLOSED_STATUSES = ("done", "parked", "cancelled", "dropped")
1165 
1166 
1167 def next_in_plan(m, n=3):
1168     """THE next-in-the-plan horizon (W1 of the steward revision, 2026-09-28), computed once here and read by its
1169     two callers: the card on the High Seat (``high_seat_card.next_html``) and the cockpit's Next steps, which
1170     renders the copy ``read_map`` puts on the map (``m["next_in_plan"]``). The declared focus first
1171     (``_focused_step``: ``current_step_id``, else the one pinned step, else the one active step — never a guess
1172     among several), then the open steps that FOLLOW it in the plan's order, done/parked/cancelled/dropped skipped;
1173     at most ``n``. Prerequisite-open steps are NOT skipped, by disposition (Grok, W1 and W3): the map's step carries
1174     no dependency field, and a second read of a slice's ``depends_on`` here is forbidden; the horizon is order, not
1175     dependency, until a field exists on the plan. With no focus: ``([], why)`` — the
1176     horizon stays empty on his surfaces; the reason is the steward's, read on the status it composes."""
1177     steps = [s for s in (m.get("steps") or []) if isinstance(s, dict)]
1178     focus, why = _focused_step(m)
1179     if focus is None:
1180         return [], why
1181     out = [focus]
1182     seen = False
1183     for s in steps:
1184         if s is focus or str(s.get("id")) == str(focus.get("id")):
1185             seen = True
1186             continue
1187         if not seen or str(s.get("status") or "") in _CLOSED_STATUSES:
1188             continue
1189         out.append(s)
1190         if len(out) >= max(1, int(n or 1)):
1191             break
1192     return out, ""
1193

1195 def _local_status_evidence(campaign_dir, m, engine_state, step):
1196     """Read explicit, current receipts rather than inferring a pass from prose."""
1197     heartbeat = m.get("heartbeat") or {}
1198     identity = {
1199         "session_id": engine_state.get("session_id") or heartbeat.get("current_session_id"),
1200         "run_id": engine_state.get("run_id") or heartbeat.get("current_run_id"),
1201     }
1202     identity = {key: str(value) for key, value in identity.items() if value is not None and str(value)}
1203     result = {
1204         "tests": "Unavailable — no check receipt for the current work and session",
1205         "journal": "Unavailable — no journal receipt for the current work and session",
1206         "eta": "Unavailable — no current estimate",
1207         "eta_source": {"state": "unavailable"},
1208         "source": {"path": "strip.json", "step_id": step.get("id") if step else None, **identity},
1209         "checks": [],
1210         "journal_source": {"state": "unavailable"},
1211     }
1212     if not step or not identity:
1213         return result
1214 
1215     def epoch(value):
1216         try:
1217             return _parse_epoch(value) if value else None
1218         except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
1219             return None
1220 
1221     def current(receipt):
1222         if not isinstance(receipt, dict):
1223             return False
1224         if receipt.get("kind") == "journal_update":     # kept across steps and rollovers
1225             return receipt.get("step_id") in (None, "") or str(receipt.get("step_id")) == str(step.get("id"))
1226         if str(receipt.get("step_id")) != str(step.get("id")):
1227             return False
1228         matches = [key for key, value in identity.items() if str(receipt.get(key) or "") == value]
1229         conflicts = [key for key, value in identity.items()
1230                      if receipt.get(key) is not None and str(receipt.get(key)) != value]
1231         return bool(matches) and not conflicts
1232 
1233     def contained_file(value):
1234         if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
1235             return None
1236         try:
1237             base = Path(campaign_dir).resolve()
1238             candidate = (base / value).resolve()
1239             relative = candidate.relative_to(base)
1240             return relative.as_posix() if candidate.is_file() else None
1241         except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
1242             return None
1243 
1244     receipts = [r for r in heartbeat.get("receipts", []) if current(r)]
1245     checks = [r for r in receipts if r.get("kind") == "local_check"]
1246     # A later run of the same command supersedes its earlier result. Different
1247     # checks remain visible, so a later pass cannot hide an unrelated failure.
1248     latest_checks = {}
1249     for receipt in sorted(checks, key=lambda r: epoch(r.get("finished_at") or r.get("started_at")) or 0):
1250         command = receipt.get("command")
1251         key = command.strip() if isinstance(command, str) and command.strip() else "(missing command)"
1252         latest_checks[key] = receipt
1253     for command, receipt in latest_checks.items():
1254         path = contained_file(receipt.get("evidence"))
1255         started = epoch(receipt.get("started_at"))
1256         finished = epoch(receipt.get("finished_at"))
1257         exit_code = receipt.get("exit_code")
1258         state, detail = "unavailable", "receipt is incomplete"
1259         if not path:
1260             detail = "evidence file is missing or outside the effort"
1261         elif command == "(missing command)" or started is None:
1262             detail = "command or start time is missing"
1263         elif exit_code is None and finished is None:
1264             state, detail = "untested", "check has not finished"
1265         elif not isinstance(exit_code, int) or isinstance(exit_code, bool) or finished is None or finished < started:
1266             detail = "completion time or exit code is invalid"
1267         elif exit_code == 0:
1268             state, detail = "passed", "exit 0"
1269         else:
1270             state, detail = "failed", f"exit {exit_code}"
1271         item = {"state": state, "command": command, "evidence": path, "detail": detail,
1272                 "started_at": receipt.get("started_at"), "finished_at": receipt.get("finished_at"),
1273                 "exit_code": exit_code, "step_id": receipt.get("step_id"),
1274                 "session_id": receipt.get("session_id"), "run_id": receipt.get("run_id")}
1275         result["checks"].append(item)
1276         estimate = receipt.get("eta")
1277         if state == "untested" and isinstance(estimate, dict):
1278             until = epoch(estimate.get("at"))
1279             basis = estimate.get("basis")
1280             if until is not None and until > time.time() and isinstance(basis, str) and basis.strip():
1281                 result["eta"] = f"Estimated {time.strftime('%H:%M', time.localtime(until))} — {basis.strip()}"
1282                 result["eta_source"] = {"state": "available", "at": estimate["at"], "basis": basis.strip(),
1283                                         "source": "local_check", "evidence": path,
1284                                         "step_id": receipt.get("step_id"), **identity}
1285     if result["checks"]:
1286         result["tests"] = "; ".join(f"{item['state'].capitalize()} — {item['command']} ({item['detail']})"
1287                                      for item in result["checks"])
1288 
1289     journals = sorted((r for r in receipts if r.get("kind") == "journal_update"),
1290                       key=lambda r: epoch(r.get("at")) or 0)
1291     if journals:
1292         receipt = journals[-1]
1293         path = contained_file(receipt.get("path"))
1294         summary = receipt.get("summary")
1295         entry_id = receipt.get("entry_id")
1296         engine_sourced = receipt.get("source") == "engine" and not receipt.get("path")   # the receipt is the record
1297         state = ("available" if (path or engine_sourced) and epoch(receipt.get("at")) is not None and entry_id
1298                  and isinstance(summary, str) and summary.strip() else "unavailable")
1299         result["journal_source"] = {"state": state, "path": path, "entry_id": entry_id,
1300                                      "at": receipt.get("at"), "step_id": receipt.get("step_id"),
1301                                      "session_id": receipt.get("session_id"), "run_id": receipt.get("run_id")}
1302         if state == "available":
1303             result["journal"] = f"{entry_id}: {summary.strip()}"
1304         else:
1305             result["journal"] = "Unavailable — current journal receipt or its file is incomplete"
1306     return result

1325 def estimate_eta(slice_, look, started_epoch, now=None):
1326     """The ETA is the length of the CURRENT SLICE: the commissioned run's own
1327     ETA when it carries one, else a typical length for the step's part tag
1328     minus the time already in — always labelled an estimate."""
1329     if look and not look.get("final") and look.get("eta"):
1330         return look["eta"] + " \u00b7 " + look["skill"]
1331     if not slice_:
1332         return ""
1333     part = slice_.get("part") or "step"
1334     typical = _PART_MINUTES.get(slice_.get("part") or "", 30)
1335     if started_epoch:
1336         elapsed = max(0, int(((now or time.time()) - started_epoch) // 60))
1337         if elapsed >= typical:
1338             return "over the ~%d min typical for a %s (%d min in \u00b7 estimate)" % (
1339                 typical, part, elapsed)
1340         return "~%d min left of a ~%d min %s (estimate \u00b7 %d min in)" % (
1341             typical - elapsed, typical, part, elapsed)
1342     return "~%d min for this %s (typical \u00b7 start unknown)" % (typical, part)

1345 def next_bullets(text, limit=3, width=90):
1346     """What's next as <=3 short bullets — split on lines, semicolons and
1347     sentence ends; each clipped at a word boundary."""
1348     parts = re.split(r"(?:\r?\n)+|;\s+|(?<=[.!?])\s+(?=[A-Z0-9(])",
1349                      str(text or "").strip())
1350     out = []
1351     for p in parts:
1352         p = re.sub(r"^[\s\-\u2022*\d.)]+", "", p).strip()
1353         if not p:
1354             continue
1355         if len(p) > width:
1356             p = p[:width - 1].rsplit(" ", 1)[0] + "\u2026"
1357         out.append(p)
1358         if len(out) >= limit:
1359             break
1360     return out
1361

1363 def project_line(m):
1364     """The overall project in one breath (the High Seat lead): the goal brief
1365     and the part tags in order, marked done / in progress."""
1366     steps = m.get("steps") or []
1367     order, seen = [], set()
1368     for s in steps:
1369         part = s.get("part") or ""
1370         if part and part not in seen:
1371             seen.add(part)
1372             order.append(part)
1373     bits = []
1374     for part in order:
1375         mine = [s for s in steps if s.get("part") == part]
1376         if mine and all(s.get("status") == "done" for s in mine):
1377             bits.append(part + " \u2713")
1378         elif any(s.get("status") == "active" for s in mine):
1379             bits.append(part + " \u25b6")
1380         else:
1381             bits.append(part)
1382     brief = m.get("goal_brief") or ""
1383     if len(brief) > 160:
1384         brief = brief[:159].rsplit(" ", 1)[0] + "\u2026"
1385     return {"brief": brief, "parts": " \u00b7 ".join(bits),
1386             "steps_done": m.get("steps_done", 0),
1387             "steps_total": m.get("steps_total", 0)}

1390 def running_code_jobs(campaign_dir):
1391     """The code jobs this steward commissioned that are still running, observed from its own job record (2026-10-05, his
1392     word: the status updates "don't seem to be congruent with what's actually happening" - a job ran for an hour while
1393     the status showed the steward's old note). [{id, title, minutes}] newest first; [] when none or unreadable."""
1394     try:
1395         raw = json.loads((Path(campaign_dir) / ".ecgberht" / "code-jobs.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
1396     except (OSError, ValueError):
1397         return []
1398     rows = raw if isinstance(raw, list) else (raw.get("jobs") or list(raw.values()) if isinstance(raw, dict) else [])
1399     out = []
1400     for r in rows:
1401         if not isinstance(r, dict) or str(r.get("status")) not in ("running", "landing", "queued"):
1402             continue
1403         title = ""
1404         for line in str(r.get("brief") or "").splitlines():
1405             line = line.strip().lstrip("#").strip()
1406             if line:
1407                 title = line[len("Work order:"):].strip() if line.lower().startswith("work order:") else line
1408                 break
1409         minutes = None
1410         try:
1411             minutes = int(max(0.0, time.time() - time.mktime(time.strptime(str(r.get("started"))[:19], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))) // 60)
1412         except (ValueError, OverflowError):
1413             pass
1414         out.append({"id": str(r.get("id") or ""), "title": title[:120] or "a code job", "minutes": minutes,
1415                     "status": str(r.get("status"))})
1416     return list(reversed(out))

1441 def compose_status(campaign_dir: str, engine_state=None):
1442     """The deterministic TWO-PART 10-minute status (handoff 2026-08-25 #2b;
1443     reworked 2026-09-04 on John's word).
1444 
1445     Zero-model, disk-true — composed from the map + the engine's own state,
1446     never from the model's memory. TOP (``now`` / ``running``): what is
1447     running at this moment, looked THROUGH the steward to the skill it
1448     commissioned (its own status log), else the attention flag, else the
1449     steward's turn. BOTTOM (``plan`` / ``slice`` / ``project``): the current
1450     slice in one line, its ETA, <=3 next bullets, and where the whole effort
1451     stands.
1452 
1453     One shape, three consumers: the cockpit's right status pane (the
1454     ``status`` event / verb), the universal file
1455     ``<cdir>/.ecgberht/status-summary.json``, and the main-dashboard tile.
1456     """
1457     m = read_map(campaign_dir)
1458     st = engine_state or {}
1459     active, focus_warning = _focused_step(m)
1460     look = status_lookthrough(campaign_dir)
1461     if m["heartbeat"].get("current_step_id"):
1462         expected_source = m["heartbeat"].get("current_skill_status_source")
1463         actual_source = look.get("source") if look else None
1464         source_matches = (isinstance(expected_source, str) and expected_source.strip()
1465                           and isinstance(actual_source, str)
1466                           and expected_source.strip().replace("\\", "/") == actual_source.strip().replace("\\", "/"))
1467         if not active or not source_matches:
1468             look = None
1469     local_evidence = _local_status_evidence(campaign_dir, m, st, active)
1470     now_lines = []
1471     running = None
1472     jobs = running_code_jobs(campaign_dir)
1473     waiting_restart = landed_not_live(campaign_dir)
1474     # 2026-10-05: a running code job is OBSERVED work - it leads, ahead of the steward's own note
1475     for j in jobs[:2]:
1476         now_lines.append("code job %s — %s%s" % (j["status"], j["title"], (" (%d min)" % j["minutes"]) if j["minutes"] is not None else ""))
1477     for w in waiting_restart[:2]:
1478         now_lines.append("landed, waits for a restart \u2014 %s" % w)
1479     if jobs:
1480         running = {"kind": "code_job", "label": now_lines[0], "skill": "coder", "source": ".ecgberht/code-jobs.json",
1481                    "age": ("%d min" % jobs[0]["minutes"]) if jobs[0]["minutes"] is not None else ""}
1482     # THE LOOK-THROUGH: the commissioned skill is what is happening;
1483     # "steward working" is the whole story only when nothing else runs.
1484     if look and not look["final"]:
1485         running = {"kind": "skill", "label": look["label"], "skill": look["skill"],
1486                    "source": look["source"], "age": look["age"]}
1487         now_lines.append(look["label"])
1488     elif m["attention"]["state"] == "working" and not jobs:
1489         run = (m["attention"]["reason"] or "").strip() \
1490             or "commissioned work in flight"
1491         if active and active.get("commissioned_as"):
1492             run += " \u00b7 as " + str(active["commissioned_as"])
1493         if not st.get("busy"):
1494             # the flag is the steward's own note: with no turn, no skill and no job running, say so (2026-10-05)
1495             run = "the steward's note says working (" + run + ") \u2014 but nothing is running now"
1496         running = {"kind": "commissioned", "label": run,
1497                    "skill": str((active or {}).get("commissioned_as") or ""),
1498                    "source": ".ecgberht/attention.json", "age": ""}
1499         now_lines.append(run)
1500     if st.get("busy"):
1501         # (2026-09-07, journals 0006/0111) a steward mid-turn cannot repaint the
1502         # pane: say so, with the turn's start and the last status on record,
1503         # instead of letting the previous status stand as if current.
1504         line = "steward mid-turn"
1505         ts0 = float(st.get("turn_started") or 0)
1506         if ts0 > 0:
1507             mins = int(max(0.0, time.time() - ts0) // 60)
1508             line += " since " + time.strftime("%H:%M", time.localtime(ts0)) + " (" + str(mins) + " min)"
1509         _last = read_last_status(campaign_dir)
1510         if _last and _last.get("at"):
1511             line += " \u00b7 last status " + str(_last["at"])[-5:]
1512         if st.get("queued"):
1513             line += " \u00b7 %d queued" % st["queued"]
1514         now_lines.append(line)
1515         if running is None:
1516             running = {"kind": "steward", "label": line, "skill": "",
1517                        "source": "engine", "age": ""}
1518     elif st.get("queued"):
1519         now_lines.append("steward idle \u00b7 %d held message(s)" % st["queued"])
1520     halt = None
1521     if look and look["final"] and (look.get("halt_reason") or look.get("limit")):
1522         reason = look.get("halt_reason") or blocker_text(look)
1523         short = reason if len(reason) <= 160 else reason[:159].rsplit(" ", 1)[0] + "\u2026"
1524         halt = {"skill": look["skill"], "reason": reason, "limit": look.get("limit") or "",
1525                 "age": look["age"], "source": look["source"]}
1526         if look.get("limit"):
1527             line = (look["skill"] + " STOPPED \u2014 model session limit (" + look["limit"]
1528                     + ") \u00b7 " + look["age"] + " ago \u00b7 " + short)
1529         else:
1530             line = look["skill"] + " STOPPED \u00b7 " + look["age"] + " ago \u00b7 " + short
1531         now_lines.insert(0, line)
1532         running = {"kind": "halted", "label": line, "skill": look["skill"],
1533                    "source": look["source"], "age": look["age"]}
1534     if look and look["final"] and running is None:
1535         done_line = look["skill"] + " finished \u00b7 " + look["age"] + " ago"
1536         if look.get("tests") and look["tests"] not in ("-", "\u2014"):

1538         now_lines.append(done_line)

1540                    "source": look["source"], "age": look["age"]}
1541     swarm = read_swarm_trails(campaign_dir)
1542     swarm_notes = []
1543     for seat in swarm:

1546                                + seat.get("age", "unknown age"))

1550                                + seat.get("reason", "invalid"))

1558             line += " \u00b7 on path"

1560     if not now_lines:
1561         attention_label = {
1562             "needs_you": "waiting on you",

1564             "blocked": "blocked",
1565             "stale": "attention stale - live owner unconfirmed",
1566             "unknown": "attention unknown",

1568         now_lines.append("nothing running - " + attention_label)

1570                    "source": "", "age": ""}

1572     if active and active.get("part"):

1575         plan_step = active["name"] if active else "(no active step)"
1576     next_text = (m["heartbeat"]["next_recommended"] or "").strip()
1577     waiting = _real_wait((m["heartbeat"]["human_wait"] or "").split("\u00b7")[0].strip())
1578     if "pending_request" in m["heartbeat"]:

1582         elif isinstance(pending, str):

1585             waiting = str(pending.get("purpose") or pending.get("question") or pending.get("text") or "").strip()
1586     if halt and not waiting and m.get("refinement") is None:

1589                    else (halt["skill"] + " stopped: ")) + halt["reason"]

1591     why_text = (m["heartbeat"].get("why_next") or "").strip()

1600         "next": next_text,

1617     slice_ = slice_of(m)

1634     latest_event = max(events, key=lambda event:event["at"]) if events else None

1637     status_line = "%s · %s/%s done · %s" % (

1651         blocker=("waiting on you: " + waiting) if waiting else ("blocked: " + halt["reason"] if halt else ""),
1652         procs=" · ".join(seats) if seats else (
1653             ((running or {}).get("skill") + " (commissioned)") if (running or {}).get("kind") == "skill" else ""),

1662     out = {"at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),

1669            "eta": estimate_eta(slice_, look, started) if live_skill and look.get("eta") else local_evidence["eta"],

1675                                if live_skill and look.get("eta") else local_evidence["eta_source"]},

1683            "plan": plan,

1687     # Deliverables count rides the universal status shape (2026-08-25, John's ask —
1688     # journal 0010: "where is the thing I paid for?"). Count only; the list itself

1690     try:

1696 def effort_line_freshness(campaign_dir: str, m=None):
1697     """The Strip's effort line with its age: ``as_of`` (the stamp's own
1698     ``active_effort_as_of`` date, else strip.json's mtime), ``newest_work`` (the
1699     newest of roadmap.json / DELIVERABLES.md / the journal), ``behind_days`` and
1700     ``stale`` (a day or more behind). Disk-true, never raises."""
1701     root = Path(campaign_dir)
1702     out = {"text": "", "as_of": "", "newest_work": "", "behind_days": 0, "stale": False}
1703     try:
1704         strip, _err = _read_json(root / "strip.json")
1705         strip = strip or {}
1706         out["text"] = str(strip.get("active_effort") or "")
1707         as_of = str(strip.get("active_effort_as_of") or "").strip()
1708         if as_of:
1709             as_of_t = time.mktime(time.strptime(as_of[:10], "%Y-%m-%d")) + 86399
1710         else:
1711             as_of_t = (root / "strip.json").stat().st_mtime
1712             as_of = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.localtime(as_of_t))
1713         out["as_of"] = as_of
1714         newest = 0.0
1715         for rel in ("roadmap.json", "DELIVERABLES.md"):
1716             try:
1717                 newest = max(newest, (root / rel).stat().st_mtime)
1718             except OSError:
1719                 pass
1720         try:
1721             for p in (root / "journal").iterdir():
1722                 if p.is_file():
1723                     newest = max(newest, p.stat().st_mtime)
1724         except OSError:
1725             pass
1726         if newest:
1727             out["newest_work"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.localtime(newest))
1728             behind = int(max(0.0, newest - as_of_t) // 86400)
1729             out["behind_days"] = behind
1730             out["stale"] = behind >= 1 and bool(out["text"])
1731     except Exception:
1732         pass
1733     return out
1734

1736 def lead_line(plan):
1737     """The ONE lead template for the pane, the top bar and the dashboard tile:
1738     what the steward said comes next and why, and who it waits on - the strip's
1739     own next_recommended / why_next / the wait; never a guess."""
1740     plan = plan if isinstance(plan, dict) else {}
1741     nxt, why = str(plan.get("next") or "").strip(), str(plan.get("why") or "").strip()
1742     line = ("Next: " + nxt + (" \u2014 " + why if why else "")) if nxt else "Next not stated by the steward"
1743     wait = str(plan.get("waiting_on_you") or "").strip()
1744     return line + (" \u00b7 waiting on you: " + wait if wait else "")

1747 def read_last_status(campaign_dir: str):
1748     """The last 10-minute status the engine PERSISTED for this effort
1749     (``<cdir>/.ecgberht/status-summary.json``), marked ``stale: True`` — or
1750     None when there is no record or it is unreadable. Read-only; the shape is
1751     exactly what :func:`compose_status` produced when it was written, so the
1752     pane paints it with the same code. Its ``at`` is the record's own stamp."""
1753     try:
1754         f = Path(campaign_dir) / ".ecgberht" / "status-summary.json"
1755         if not f.is_file():
1756             return None
1757         d = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
1758         if not isinstance(d, dict) or not d.get("at"):
1759             return None
1760         d["stale"] = True
1761         d.setdefault("lead_line", lead_line(d.get("plan")))   # a record written before the lead existed
1762         return d
1763     except Exception:
1764         return None

1767 def status_for_pane(campaign_dir: str, engine_state=None, live: bool = False):
1768     """What a status pane shows - the cockpit's pane, the High Seat's tile, the Desk: ONE rule (2026-10-01, his word:
1769     the Status in an expanded tile "looks dated/old"). A LIVE engine: composed fresh from the map and its state. No
1770     live engine: composed fresh from the RECORD as it is now (the summary, the status, the next bullets, the lead) -
1771     never the persisted summary alone, whose "Doing" was a run that ended and whose plan may have moved since (the
1772     2026-09-03 rule showed that summary whole; his eye read it as old). The last run is named once, by its date: on
1773     the "Doing" line and as ``last_run_at`` for the pane's header; ``from_record`` says the pane is the record now.
1774     Nothing is grafted from the old summary into the fresh table (Grok's read: that was a second status in one pane)
1775     and nothing is marked stale."""
1776     if live:
1777         return compose_status(campaign_dir, engine_state)
1778     fresh = compose_status(campaign_dir, None)
1779     fresh["from_record"] = True
1780     last = read_last_status(campaign_dir)
1781     if not isinstance(last, dict) or not last.get("at"):
1782         return fresh
1783     stamp = str(last["at"])[-16:]
1784     fresh["last_run_at"] = str(last["at"])
1785     for f in ((fresh.get("compact") or {}).get("facts") or []):
1786         if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("label") == "Doing":
1787             f["value"] = "%s \u00b7 the last run %s" % (f.get("value") or "nothing running", stamp)
1788     return fresh

1791 def _safe_route_seg(seg: str) -> bool:
1792     """The same safe class ``anchor_gui._unsafe_path_seg`` enforces (mirrored
1793     here so this zero-import reader stays standalone): a non-empty segment with
1794     no path separator and no parent-dir traversal."""
1795     return bool(seg) and "/" not in seg and "\\" not in seg and ".." not in seg
1796 
1797 
1798 def classify_route(token: str):
1799     """Classify a Where-cell token as a CONTAINED Anchor route — or None.
1800 
1801     Only Anchor's own contained route grammars qualify, judged on the route's
1802     OWN grammar (never a request-pid comparison — a cross-project register
1803     link is a token-gated app route, not traversal):
1804 
1805     - ``/report/<pid>/<lane>[/<job_id>]`` — every segment in the safe class
1806       :func:`_safe_route_seg` (mirrors ``anchor_gui._unsafe_path_seg``);
1807     - ``/artifact/<pid>?path=<rel>`` — ``rel`` relative, with no ``..`` /
1808       absolute / drive / backslash segment and no second query key.
1809 
1810     Any ``http(s)://``, protocol-relative ``//``, ``../`` or other
1811     traversal-bearing token yields None (the row renders as text)."""
1812     if not token or not isinstance(token, str):
1813         return None
1814     t = token.strip()
1815     if t.startswith("/report/"):
1816         if "?" in t:
1817             return None
1818         segs = t[len("/report/"):].split("/")
1819         if len(segs) in (2, 3) and all(_safe_route_seg(s) for s in segs):
1820             return t
1821         return None
1822     if t.startswith("/artifact/"):
1823         pid, sep, query = t[len("/artifact/"):].partition("?")
1824         if not sep or not _safe_route_seg(pid):
1825             return None
1826         if "&" in query or not query.startswith("path="):
1827             return None
1828         rel = query[len("path="):]
1829         if not rel or rel.startswith("/") or "\\" in rel \
1830                 or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", rel):
1831             return None
1832         if any(not seg or ".." in seg for seg in rel.split("/")):
1833             return None
1834         return t
1835     return None
1836 
1837 
1838 def _read_deliverables(campaign_dir: str):
1839     """Parse ``<cdir>/DELIVERABLES.md`` — THE campaign deliverables register (the
1840     steward's OWN convention, campaign journal 0010: one table row per thing a
1841     human would open; standing rule = a step producing a human-facing artifact is
1842     not done until listed here). Disk-true, zero-model, one source of truth — the
1843     cockpit never keeps a second registry.
1844 
1845     THE HEADER CONTRACT (written down once, here): the register is a pipe table
1846     ``| What | Where | Date | Step |`` — Step optional per row. The Where cell
1847     carries the open target (a backticked or bare in-effort path, or a contained
1848     Anchor route per :func:`classify_route`) and may ALSO carry a
1849     ``run: <command>`` marker (backticked ``run: `<command>` `` form too); a row
1850     may carry BOTH an open target and a run command.
1851 
1852     Returns ``{"exists": bool, "items": [{"what", "where_text", "path", "route",
1853     "run", "date", "step", "openable"}]}``. ``path`` is the first backticked span
1854     of the Where cell, resolved against the campaign dir; ``openable`` is True
1855     ONLY when the resolved real path stays INSIDE the campaign dir (containment —
1856     entries pointing outside, e.g. ``../…``, render as text, never as links) OR
1857     when the cell names a contained Anchor route (``route`` set, ``path`` None).
1858     ``run`` is the exact command string after the ``run:`` marker — stored
1859     verbatim, no shell parsing, no evaluation, never executed here."""
1860     f = Path(campaign_dir) / "DELIVERABLES.md"
1861     if not f.is_file():
1862         return {"exists": False, "items": _plan_doc_rows(campaign_dir, [])}
1863     try:
1864         cdir_real = os.path.realpath(str(campaign_dir))
1865         items = []
1866         for line in f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
1867             s = line.strip()
1868             if not (s.startswith("|") and s.endswith("|")):
1869                 continue
1870             cells = [c.strip() for c in s.strip("|").split("|")]
1871             if len(cells) < 3 or set(cells[0]) <= {"-", " ", ":"} \
1872                or cells[0].lower() == "what":
1873                 continue
1874             what, where_text, date = cells[0], cells[1], cells[2]
1875             path_rel, openable, route, run_cmd = None, False, None, None
1876             # (2026-09-05) a `run:` marker anywhere in the cell stores the
1877             # EXACT command string — no shell parsing, no evaluation, never
1878             # executed here. Backticked form matched first so a backticked
1879             # command is never mistaken for the open-target span; the marker
1880             # is removed from the cell before the open target is extracted.
1881             cell = where_text
1882             m_run = re.search(r"run:\s*(?:`([^`]+)`|(\S[^|]*))", where_text)
1883             if m_run:
1884                 run_cmd = m_run.group(1) if m_run.group(1) is not None \
1885                     else m_run.group(2).strip()
1886                 cell = (where_text[:m_run.start()]
1887                         + where_text[m_run.end():]).strip()
1888             m_bt = re.search(r"`([^`]+)`", cell)
1889             # (2026-09-04) a register row written without backticks (the
1890             # Fractal Orthogonal Basis effort: "report/DRAFT-v1.md") must still
1891             # open: fall back to the cell's first token that names a file.
1892             cand_plain = None
1893             if not m_bt:
1894                 for tok in cell.replace(",", " ").split():
1895                     tok = tok.strip().strip("()[]")
1896                     if "/" in tok or "." in tok:
1897                         cand_plain = tok
1898                         break
1899             if m_bt or cand_plain:
1900                 cand = (m_bt.group(1).strip() if m_bt else cand_plain)
1901                 if cand.startswith("/report/") or cand.startswith("/artifact/"):
1902                     # (2026-09-05) a route-shaped token is judged by the
1903                     # contained grammar ONLY — a hostile cell gets route None
1904                     # and stays text; it never reaches the filesystem branch.
1905                     route = classify_route(cand)
1906                     openable = route is not None
1907                 else:
1908                     try:
1909                         real = os.path.realpath(str(Path(campaign_dir) / cand))
1910                         if (real == cdir_real
1911                                 or real.startswith(cdir_real + os.sep)) \
1912                                 and os.path.isfile(real):
1913                             path_rel = os.path.relpath(real, cdir_real).replace(os.sep, "/")
1914                             openable = True
1915                         else:
1916                             path_rel = cand
1917                     except OSError:
1918                         path_rel = cand
1919             items.append({"what": re.sub(r"\*\*", "", what),
1920                           "where_text": where_text,
1921                           "path": path_rel,
1922                           "route": route,
1923                           "run": run_cmd,
1924                           "date": date,
1925                           # optional 4th column (John, 2026-08-26): which
1926                           # roadmap step produced it — a step NUMBER or a
1927                           # name fragment; the map embeds the link there
1928                           "step": cells[3].strip() if len(cells) > 3 else "",
1929                           "openable": openable})
1930         refinement = read_refinement(campaign_dir, stale_ok=True)
1931         if refinement is not None:
1932             if not refinement.get("ok"):
1933                 return {"exists": True, "items": items, "error": refinement.get("error")}
1934             managed = refinement_items(campaign_dir, refinement["state"])
1935             paths = {item["path"] for item in managed}
1936             items = managed + [item for item in items if item.get("path") not in paths]
1937         approved = [{**item, "what": item["product_id"], "step": item["step_id"],
1938             "date": item.get("accepted_at", ""), "accepted": True, "openable": True, "managed": True}
1939             for item in (refinement or {}).get("approved_products", [])]
1940         for item in items:
1941             item["accepted_current"] = bool((refinement or {}).get("current_approvals", {})
1942                 .get(item.get("step"), {}).get(item.get("product_id"), False))
1943             if item.get("managed"):
1944                 item["history"] = [v for v in item.get("history", []) if v.get("revision_id") != item.get("revision_id")]
1945         from anchor_notebooks import decorate
1946         return {"exists": True, "approved": approved,
1947                 "finished_projection": (refinement or {}).get("finished_projection"),
1948                 "items": [decorate(campaign_dir, item)
1949                 for item in items + _plan_doc_rows(campaign_dir, items)]}
1950     except Exception:
1951         return {"exists": True, "items": []}
