1954 def _plan_doc_rows(campaign_dir, listed, depth=2):
1955     """(John, 2026-09-04) a plan for going forward is a clickable link in the
1956     work flow without anyone registering it: every PLAN / MASTER-PLAN /
1957     IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN / NORTH-STAR / *-PLAN document up to two levels
1958     under the campaign dir that the register does not already list becomes
1959     an ``auto`` row (openable — it is inside the campaign by construction)."""
1960     root = Path(campaign_dir)
1961     try:
1962         cdir_real = os.path.realpath(str(root))
1963     except OSError:
1964         return []
1965     have = set()
1966     for it in listed or []:
1967         p = it.get("path")
1968         if p:
1969             have.add(os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(os.path.join(cdir_real, p))))
1970     rows = []
1971 
1972     def walk(d, level):
1973         try:
1974             entries = sorted(d.iterdir(), key=lambda p: p.name.lower())
1975         except OSError:
1976             return
1977         for p in entries:
1978             name = p.name
1979             try:
1980                 is_dir = p.is_dir()
1981             except OSError:
1982                 continue
1983             if is_dir:
1984                 if level < depth and name not in _LOOK_SKIP_DIRS \
1985                         and not name.startswith((".", "_")):
1986                     walk(p, level + 1)
1987                 continue
1988             if not _PLAN_DOC_NAME.match(name):
1989                 continue
1990             try:
1991                 real = os.path.realpath(str(p))
1992                 if os.path.normcase(real) in have:
1993                     continue
1994                 relp = os.path.relpath(real, cdir_real).replace(os.sep, "/")
1995                 date = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.localtime(p.stat().st_mtime))
1996             except OSError:
1997                 continue
1998             have.add(os.path.normcase(real))
1999             rows.append({"what": "Plan \u00b7 " + relp, "where_text": relp,
2000                          "path": relp, "route": None, "run": None,
2001                          "date": date, "step": "",
2002                          "openable": True, "auto": True})
2003 
2004     walk(root, 0)
2005     return rows
2006

2008 def read_history(campaign_dir: str, tail: int = TAIL_TURNS):
2009     """The campaign conversation so far - what was said, not state."""
2010     log, err = _read_json(Path(campaign_dir) / ".ecgberht" / "conversation-log.json")
2011     if err or not log:
2012         return {"turns": [], "note": f"conversation log {err or 'empty'}"}
2013     turns = log.get("turns") or []
2014     out = [{"role": t.get("role", "steward"),
2015             "text": t.get("text", ""),
2016             "at": t.get("at", "")} for t in turns[-tail:]]
2017     note = "" if len(turns) <= tail else f"showing last {tail} of {len(turns)} turns"
2018     return {"turns": out, "note": note}

2092 #: An effort retired IN PLACE (2026-09-03): Windows refuses to rename a folder
2093 #: while anything inside it is open (a deck in PowerPoint, an Explorer window,
2094 #: a terminal's cwd) — WinError 5/32. Rather than fail, the effort stays where
2095 #: it is and carries this marker; it leaves the live list and joins the
2096 #: boneyard list exactly like a moved one. Resurrecting removes the marker.
2097 RETIRED_MARKER = ".ecgberht/retired.json"
2098 
2099 
2100 def retired_marker_path(effort_dir: str) -> Path:
2101     return Path(effort_dir) / RETIRED_MARKER
2102 
2103 
2104 def is_retired_in_place(effort_dir: str) -> bool:
2105     try:
2106         return retired_marker_path(effort_dir).is_file()
2107     except OSError:
2108         return False
2109

2111 def retire_in_place(effort_dir: str, why: str = "") -> dict:
2112     """Write the in-place retirement marker. Returns the record written."""
2113     f = retired_marker_path(effort_dir)
2114     f.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2115     rec = {"retired": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "in_place": True,
2116            "why": why or "files in the effort were open when it was retired"}
2117     f.write_text(json.dumps(rec, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
2118     return rec
2119 
2120 
2121 def resurrect_in_place(effort_dir: str) -> bool:
2122     """Remove the marker; True if one was there."""
2123     f = retired_marker_path(effort_dir)
2124     if not f.is_file():
2125         return False
2126     f.unlink()
2127     return True

2130 def list_boneyard(root_dir: str):
2131     """Efforts resting in <root>/_boneyard PLUS efforts retired in place
2132     (marker), newest burial first."""
2133     root = Path(root_dir)
2134     yard = root / BONEYARD_DIRNAME
2135     out = []
2136 
2137     def _row(p, when, in_place):
2138         m = read_map(str(p))
2139         out.append({"name": p.name, "goal_brief": m["goal_brief"],
2140                     "steps_done": m["steps_done"],
2141                     "steps_total": m["steps_total"], "boneyarded": when,
2142                     "in_place": in_place})
2143 
2144     if yard.is_dir():
2145         for p in sorted(yard.iterdir()):
2146             if not (p / "ECGBERHT.md").is_file():
2147                 continue
2148             try:
2149                 when = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.localtime(p.stat().st_mtime))
2150             except OSError:
2151                 when = ""
2152             _row(p, when, False)
2153     try:
2154         subs = sorted(p for p in root.iterdir()
2155                       if p.is_dir() and not p.name.startswith((".", "_")))
2156     except OSError:
2157         subs = []
2158     for p in subs:
2159         if not (p / "ECGBERHT.md").is_file() or not is_retired_in_place(str(p)):
2160             continue
2161         try:
2162             rec = json.loads(retired_marker_path(str(p)).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
2163             when = str(rec.get("retired") or "")[:10]
2164         except Exception:
2165             when = ""
2166         _row(p, when, True)
2167     out.sort(key=lambda x: x["boneyarded"], reverse=True)
2168     return out

2178 def _step_needs_attention(step):
2179     if not step:
2180         return False

2182         return True
2183     r = step.get("refinement") if isinstance(step.get("refinement"), dict) else None
2184     if r and r.get("phase") in ("awaiting_review", "blocked"):
2185         return True
2186     return any(h.get("status") == "pending_steward_review"
2187                for h in (r or {}).get("producer_handoffs") or [] if isinstance(h, dict))

2190 def _stream_mark(steps):

2194         return {"glyph": "✓", "cls": "done"}
2195     if any(_step_needs_attention(s) for s in steps):

2197     return {"glyph": "▷", "cls": "todo"}

2212 def work_stream_model(map_, items):
2213     """Same work-stream tree the cockpit Deliverables panel paints."""
2214     from .navigation_compat import with_compat_navigation, resolve_step
2215     map_ = map_ or {"name": "Project work", "steps": []}
2216     if not map_.get("navigation_mode"):
2217         map_ = with_compat_navigation(map_)
2218     steps = list((map_ or {}).get("steps") or [])
2219     definitions, featured = {}, set()
2220     fallback = map_.get("navigation_fallback") or {}
2221     for g in fallback.get("groups") or []:
2222         definitions[g["id"]] = g
2223     for s in steps:
2224         n = s.get("navigation") or {}
2225         for g in n.get("groups") or []:
2226             if isinstance(g, dict) and g.get("id"):
2227                 definitions[g["id"]] = g
2228         for p in n.get("featured_paths") or []:
2229             featured.add(str(p).replace("\\", "/").lower())
2230     roots, all_nodes, step_groups, overrides, related = [], {}, {}, {}, {}
2231 
2232     def ensure(path):
2233         if not (isinstance(path, list) and 0 < len(path) <= 2 and all(isinstance(g, str) and g in definitions for g in path)):
2234             definitions["unclassified"] = {"id": "unclassified",
2235                                            "label": "Other work — needs organization", "order": 99999}
2236             path = [fallback["id"], "unclassified"] if fallback.get("id") else ["unclassified"]
2237         parent = None
2238         node = None
2239         for gid in path:
2240             g = definitions[gid]
2241             node = all_nodes.get(g["id"])
2242             if node is None:
2243                 node = {**g, "children": [], "steps": [], "items": [], "reference_steps": [], "reference_items": [], "parent": parent}
2244                 all_nodes[g["id"]] = node
2245                 (parent["children"] if parent else roots).append(node)
2246             parent = node
2247         return node
2248 
2249     if fallback.get("id"):
2250         ensure([fallback["id"]])
2251         for c in fallback.get("components") or []:
2252             ensure([fallback["id"], c["id"]])
2253     for i, s in enumerate(steps):
2254         n = s.get("navigation") or {}
2255         group = ensure(n.get("path"))
2256         group["steps"].append(s)
2257         step_groups[s.get("id")] = group
2258         for path in n.get("include_paths") or []:
2259             ensure(path)
2260         refs = []
2261         for path in n.get("related_paths") or []:
2262             ref = ensure(path)
2263             if ref is not group and not any(ref is existing for existing in refs):
2264                 ref["reference_steps"].append(s)
2265                 refs.append(ref)
2266         related[s.get("id")] = refs
2267         for o in n.get("items") or []:
2268             if isinstance(o, dict) and isinstance(o.get("source_path"), str):
2269                 overrides[o["source_path"].replace("\\", "/").lower()] = ensure(o.get("path"))
2270     for it in items or []:
2271         group = overrides.get(str(it.get("path") or "").replace("\\", "/").lower())
2272         matched = resolve_step(steps, it.get("owner_step_id") if "owner_step_id" in it else it.get("step"))
2273         if group is None:
2274             if matched is not None:
2275                 group = step_groups.get(matched.get("id"))
2276         (group or ensure(None))["items"].append(it)
2277         if matched is not None:
2278             for ref in related.get(matched.get("id"), []):
2279                 if ref is not group:
2280                     ref["reference_items"].append(it)
2281     def group_steps(node):
2282         found = node["steps"] + node["reference_steps"]
2283         for child in node["children"]:
2284             found += group_steps(child)
2285         return list({id(s): s for s in found}.values())
2286     def sort_nodes(nodes):
2287         nodes.sort(key=lambda n: (n.get("order") or 0, n.get("label") or ""))
2288         for n in nodes:
2289             sort_nodes(n["children"])
2290             n["items"].sort(key=lambda it: (1 if it.get("managed") else 0,
2291                                             str(it.get("date") or "")), reverse=True)
2292             collected = group_steps(n)
2293             primary = [s for s in collected if (s.get("navigation") or {}).get("role") == "primary"]
2294             n["mark"] = _stream_mark(primary or collected)
2295     sort_nodes(roots)
2296     return {"roots": roots, "featured": featured}
2297

2299 def current_review_items(map_, items):
2300     from .navigation_compat import resolve_step
2301     steps = (map_ or {}).get("steps") or []
2302     current = []
2303     for it in items or []:
2304         owner = resolve_step(steps, it.get("step"))
2305         if owner is None:
2306             continue
2307         nav = (owner or {}).get("navigation") or {}
2308         if it.get("accepted") or it.get("accepted_current"):
2309             continue
2310         if it.get("managed") and it.get("phase") in ("awaiting_review", "blocked"):
2311             current.append(it)                 # asked for review: stays whatever the focus (journal 0132)
2312             continue
2313         if nav.get("current") is False or nav.get("role") == "support" or (owner or {}).get("status") == "parked":
2314             continue
2315         if it.get("managed") and it.get("phase") != "done":
2316             current.append(it)
2317         elif not it.get("managed") and owner and owner.get("status") != "done" and (owner.get("refinement") or {}).get("phase") != "done":
2318             normalize = lambda p: str(p or "").replace("\\", "/").lower()
2319             featured = {normalize(p) for p in nav.get("featured_paths") or []}
2320             designation = re.match(r"^(?:START\s+HERE|CURRENT|FOR\s+REVIEW)\s*(?:[:—–-]|$)", str(it.get("what") or ""), re.I)
2321             historical = re.match(r"^(?:HISTORICAL|SUPERSEDED|ARCHIVED|EARLIER|PREVIOUS)\b", str(it.get("what") or ""), re.I)
2322             if not historical and (normalize(it.get("path")) in featured or designation):
2323                 current.append(it)
2324     current.sort(key=lambda it: str(it.get("date") or ""), reverse=True)
2325     return current

2328 def read_deliverables(campaign_dir: str):

2345 def review_acts(map_, current_items):
2346     """What John does now, in order: review each product awaiting him (from the
2347     current list), open the current step's featured file, then what the steward
2348     said comes next. (The open decision is added by the page from the engine state.)"""
2349     acts = []
2350     for it in current_items:
2351         if it.get("managed") and it.get("phase") in ("awaiting_review", "blocked"):
2352             acts.append({"act": "Review", "label": str(it.get("what") or it.get("product_id") or it.get("path") or "").replace("-", " "),
2353                          "path": it.get("path"), "step": it.get("step"), "item": it})
2354     cur, _warn = _focused_step(map_)
2355     row = next((it for it in current_items if not it.get("managed")), None)   # the current step's own file (featured or designated)
2356     if row:
2357         acts.append({"act": "Open", "label": str(row.get("what") or row.get("path") or "").strip(),
2358                      "path": row.get("path"), "step": row.get("step"), "item": row})
2359     nxt = ((map_ or {}).get("heartbeat") or {}).get("next_recommended") or ""
2360     if str(nxt).strip():
2361         acts.append({"act": "Next", "label": str(nxt).strip(), "step": (cur or {}).get("id")})
2362     return acts

2398 def discover_efforts(root_dir: str):
2399     """Steward efforts under a project: the project root itself (if it has a
2400     Face) plus one level of subdirs carrying their own ECGBERHT.md - the same
2401     one-level rule the engine's discovery uses. Deterministic, read-only."""
2402     root = Path(root_dir)
2403     efforts = []
2404     candidates = [root]
2405     try:
2406         candidates += sorted(
2407             p for p in root.iterdir()
2408             if p.is_dir() and p.name not in ("node_modules", ".git", "vendor")
2409             and not p.name.startswith((".", "_"))
2410         )
2411     except OSError:
2412         pass
2413     for p in candidates:
2414         if (p / "ECGBERHT.md").is_file():
2415             if p != root and is_retired_in_place(str(p)):
2416                 continue  # resting in place — it is in the boneyard list
2417             efforts.append({
2418                 "rel": "" if p == root else p.name,
2419                 "name": root.name if p == root else p.name,
2420             })
2421     return efforts

2424 def map_stamp(campaign_dir: str):

2428     for rel in ("ECGBERHT.md", "roadmap.json", "strip.json", "DELIVERABLES.md",
2429                 ".ecgberht/attention.json"):
2430         try:
2431             stamp.append((root / rel).stat().st_mtime_ns)
2432         except OSError:
2433             stamp.append(0)
2434     try:   # W2d: a guide the steward wrote reloads the page that shows it
2435         for gp in sorted((root / "goals").glob("*/GUIDE.md")):
2436             stamp.append(gp.stat().st_mtime_ns)
2437     except OSError:
2438         pass

2442 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2443 # The goal's guide (W2d of the active set, 2026-09-30; PLAN v1.3.1 fit 11): the high-level planning guide of ONE goal
2444 # - goals/<goal id>/GUIDE.md under the Campaign - written by the Campaign's steward on his word in the goal's
2445 # conversation ("write the guide" / "update the guide") from what he dictated there and the record, never unasked;
2446 # revised by him in the goal's place (write_guide, his hand on it); its history a dated line per change under
2447 # "## History" and the Campaign repo's commits. The head, the nudges and the deliverables read it (the standing text).
2448 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2449 
2450 _GOAL_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,80}$")      # the sections are the standing text's (SKILL.md item 8), named once there
2451 
2452 
2453 def guide_rel(goal_id):
2454     """The guide's path inside the Campaign for a goal id, or None for an id that is not one (never a path)."""
2455     gid = str(goal_id or "").strip()
2456     if not _GOAL_ID.match(gid) or ".." in gid:
2457         return None
2458     return "goals/%s/GUIDE.md" % gid
2459 
2460 
2461 def guide_body(text):
2462     """The guide without its History section - the page shows the history once, folded (Grok's read of W2d)."""
2463     out, skipping = [], False
2464     for ln in str(text or "").splitlines():
2465         if ln.startswith("## "):
2466             skipping = ln[3:].strip().lower() == "history"
2467             if skipping:
2468                 continue
2469         if not skipping:
2470             out.append(ln)
2471     return "\n".join(out).rstrip("\n") + "\n"
2472 
2473 
2474 def _guide_history(text):
2475     lines, on = [], False
2476     for ln in str(text or "").splitlines():
2477         if ln.startswith("## "):
2478             on = ln[3:].strip().lower() == "history"
2479             continue
2480         if on and ln.strip().startswith("- "):
2481             lines.append(ln.strip()[2:].strip())
2482     return lines
2483 
2484 
2485 def read_guide(campaign_dir, goal_id):
2486     """{exists, text, updated, history, rel}; a missing guide is exists False, never an error."""
2487     rel = guide_rel(goal_id)
2488     out = {"exists": False, "text": "", "updated": "", "history": [], "rel": rel or ""}
2489     if not rel:
2490         return out
2491     path = Path(campaign_dir) / rel
2492     try:
2493         text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
2494         st = path.stat()
2495     except OSError:
2496         return out
2497     out.update(exists=True, text=text.replace("\r\n", "\n"), updated=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", time.localtime(st.st_mtime)), history=_guide_history(text))
2498     return out
2499 
2500 
2501 def _with_history_line(body, line):
2502     """The line appended at the END of the History section (made last when absent), wherever that section sits."""
2503     lines = body.split("\n")
2504     start = next((i for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if ln.strip().lower() == "## history"), None)
2505     if start is None:
2506         return body.rstrip("\n") + "\n\n## History\n" + line + "\n"
2507     end = next((i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith("## ")), len(lines))
2508     while end > start + 1 and not lines[end - 1].strip():
2509         end -= 1
2510     lines.insert(end, line)
2511     return "\n".join(lines).rstrip("\n") + "\n"
2512 
2513 
2514 def _commit_paths(campaign_dir, rels, message):
2515     """The Campaign's own paths only, and only when the Campaign folder IS a repo's root (a Campaign inside some parent
2516     repo is left to that repo's owner - Grok's read of W2d); git's word is the note, never a failure of the write."""
2517     import subprocess
2518     try:
2519         probe = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], cwd=str(campaign_dir), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
2520         top = probe.stdout.strip().replace("/", os.sep).rstrip(os.sep).lower() if probe.returncode == 0 else ""
2521         here = os.path.normpath(os.path.realpath(str(campaign_dir))).rstrip(os.sep).lower()
2522         if not top or os.path.normpath(os.path.realpath(top)).lower() != here:
2523             return "not committed (the Campaign is not a repo here)"
2524         add = subprocess.run(["git", "add", "--", *rels], cwd=str(campaign_dir), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
2525         if add.returncode != 0:
2526             return "commit failed: " + ((add.stderr or add.stdout).strip().splitlines() or ["git add refused"])[-1]
2527         c = subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", message, "--", *rels], cwd=str(campaign_dir), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
2528         if c.returncode != 0:
2529             tail = (c.stderr or c.stdout).strip().splitlines()
2530             return "commit failed: " + (tail[-1] if tail else "git exit %d" % c.returncode)
2531         return "committed"
2532     except Exception as e:
2533         return "commit failed: " + str(e)
2534 
2535 
2536 def write_guide(campaign_dir, goal_id, text, who="John"):
2537     """His revision from the goal's place: the whole file as he left it, one dated History line added, written whole
2538     (a temp file then a replace), committed when the Campaign is a repo. {ok, rel, updated, history, note} or {ok, error}."""
2539     rel = guide_rel(goal_id)
2540     if not rel:
2541         return {"ok": False, "error": "no such goal"}
2542     body = str(text or "").replace("\r\n", "\n").strip("\n")
2543     if not body.strip():
2544         return {"ok": False, "error": "an empty guide is not written - say what the goal is"}
2545     stamp = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
2546     body = _with_history_line(body, "- %s \u2014 revised by %s in the goal\u2019s place" % (stamp, who))
2547     path = Path(campaign_dir) / rel
2548     try:
2549         path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2550         tmp = path.with_name("GUIDE.md.tmp")
2551         tmp.write_text(body, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
2552         os.replace(str(tmp), str(path))
2553     except OSError as e:
2554         return {"ok": False, "error": "the guide could not be written: %s" % e}
2555     note = _commit_paths(campaign_dir, [rel], "guide of %s revised by %s in the goal's place" % (goal_id, who))
2556     return {"ok": True, "rel": rel, "updated": stamp, "history": _guide_history(body), "note": note}

2559 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2560 # Plan drift (John, 2026-09-05: "the plan does not get updated when there are
2561 # clear instructions to add elements, or if a new North Star is created and a
2562 # plan to go with it"). The plan John SEES is roadmap.json; a plan document is
2563 # not the plan until the steward folds it in. These are the mechanism: the
2564 # reader never shows an empty outline while a plan document exists, and every
2565 # human turn carries the drift line to the model until the roadmap catches up.
2566 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2567 
2568 def _plan_docs(root: Path):
2569     """Plan documents in the campaign dir (top level only), newest first."""
2570     out = []
2571     try:
2572         for p in root.iterdir():
2573             if p.is_file() and _PLAN_DOC_NAME.match(p.name):
2574                 out.append(p)
2575     except OSError:
2576         return []
2577     out.sort(key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime if p.exists() else 0, reverse=True)
2578     return out
2579 
2580 
2581 def _steps_from_plan_doc(root: Path):
2582     """Proposed steps from the newest plan document's ``## `` headings (skipping
2583     front matter such as Goal / Success / Non-goals). Returns (steps, name)."""
2584     docs = _plan_docs(root)
2585     if not docs:
2586         return [], ""
2587     doc = docs[0]
2588     try:
2589         text = doc.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
2590     except OSError:
2591         return [], ""
2592     skip = re.compile(r"^(goal|observable success|success criteria|non-goals?|risk|foresight|sources?|"
2593                       r"the deliverable|elegance|adversary|property gates|hardening)", re.I)
2594     steps = []
2595     for line in text.splitlines():
2596         m = re.match(r"^##\s+(.+?)\s*$", line)
2597         if not m:
2598             continue
2599         name = re.sub(r"\s*\(.*?\)\s*$", "", m.group(1)).strip()
2600         if not name or skip.match(name):
2601             continue
2602         n = len(steps) + 1
2603         steps.append({
2604             "id": f"d{n:02d}", "name": name, "status": "proposed", "done_when": "",
2605             "waiting_on": None, "commissioned_as": None, "part": "", "gate": "",
2606             "derived_from": doc.name,
2607         })
2608     return steps, doc.name
2609 
2610 
2611 def plan_drift(campaign_dir: str):
2612     """Is the roadmap behind the plan documents? Pure, disk-true, never raises."""
2613     refinement = read_refinement(campaign_dir)
2614     if refinement is not None:
2615         status = refinement.get("projection_status", {})
2616         return {"drift": not (refinement.get("ok") and status.get("consistent")),
2617                 "reason": "" if refinement.get("ok") and status.get("consistent") else str(status.get("error") or refinement.get("error") or "projection-lag"),
2618                 "docs": ["PLAN.md"], "generation": status.get("generation")}
2619     root = Path(campaign_dir)
2620     docs = _plan_docs(root)
2621     if not docs:
2622         return {"drift": False, "reason": "", "docs": []}
2623     rm = root / "roadmap.json"
2624     names = [p.name for p in docs]
2625     try:
2626         rm_m = rm.stat().st_mtime
2627     except OSError:
2628         return {"drift": True, "docs": names,
2629                 "reason": f"{names[0]} exists but roadmap.json has not been written"}
2630     data, err = _read_json(rm)
2631     proj = (data or {}).get("roadmap_projection") or []
2632     if not proj:
2633         return {"drift": True, "docs": names,
2634                 "reason": f"{names[0]} exists but roadmap.json has no steps"}
2635     newer = [p.name for p in docs if p.stat().st_mtime > rm_m + 1]
2636     if newer:
2637         when = time.strftime("%H:%M", time.localtime(docs[0].stat().st_mtime))
2638         return {"drift": True, "docs": names,
2639                 "reason": f"{newer[0]} changed at {when}, after roadmap.json"}
2640     return {"drift": False, "reason": "", "docs": names}

2643 def plan_drift_suffix(campaign_dir: str) -> str:
2644     """The line appended to a human turn on the model's stdin while the roadmap
2645     is behind the plan. Empty when there is no drift."""
2646     d = plan_drift(campaign_dir)
2647     if not d.get("drift"):
2648         return ""
2649     return ("\n\n[cockpit, not John] PLAN DRIFT: " + d["reason"] + ". The plan John sees is "
2650             "roadmap.json, not the document: fold the document (and anything he just asked to "
2651             "add, remove or reorder) into roadmap.json in THIS turn - step_create / step_set "
2652             "events plus the projection - then say in one line what changed in the plan.")
